assets.name: memory-event-stories
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: children's thinking-game event-card atlas, exactly SIX square panels in a precise 3-column by 2-row grid on a 1536 by 1024 landscape canvas. Warm detailed hand-painted picture-book illustrations on cream paper, like a gentle illustrated children's book; clear silhouettes and large actions usable as 130px cards. Each panel is independent, perfectly centered in its equal cell, with a modest cream margin; no connecting arrows, no numbers, no text, no borders intruding into adjacent cells. Top row is one consistent white rabbit carrying red apples and a friendly ginger kitten story: top-left, the white rabbit walks out of its home carrying a small basket of red apples, dry early morning path; top-middle, the SAME white rabbit and basket wait under the leafy canopy of a tree while ordinary rain falls beyond the canopy, no lightning or storm; top-right, after rain, that white rabbit hands a red apple from its basket to the SAME ginger kitten, both clearly visible. Bottom row is one consistent brown bear and brown-and-white puppy story by a tiny calm stream: bottom-left, brown bear picks up a long wooden plank from a small stack on the bank, bridge not built yet; bottom-middle, puppy at one bank holds one end of a plank while the bear at the opposite bank lowers the other end across the very narrow stream, visibly cooperating to build the wooden bridge; bottom-right, bear and puppy walk together over the now completed stable short plank bridge, full bridge and both banks visible. Preserve characters and objects within each story. Each tile contains just its specified event, no composites, no extra event or answers. NO WORDS, NO LABELS, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS, NO WATERMARK.

assets.name: everyday-actions
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: nine independent daily-action cards for a child-friendly object-to-use matching game. Exactly 3 columns by 3 rows of equally sized square panels, 1536 by 1536 square canvas. Gentle hand-painted picture-book style, warm natural colors, cream paper backgrounds, clear close or medium views. Each action fills its cell, with breathing room; NO textual labels, numbers, arrows, watermarks. Row 1 left: child lifts a simple handled drinking cup to lips and drinks water. Row 1 middle: close-up hand uses a pencil to draw one clear straight line on white paper, NO ruler or other tool. Row 1 right: child uses a soft towel to dry wet hands, small remaining water droplets make drying recognizable. Row 2 left: child holds an OPEN umbrella overhead shielding from visible rain, the umbrella and rain both clear. Row 2 middle: child outdoors under warm sunshine wearing a wide-brimmed sun hat, the brim visibly shades the face; NO umbrella. Row 2 right: close-up hands put rice and vegetables INTO an open lunchbox, food and container clearly visible; not merely eating. Row 3 left: child assembles several large colorful building blocks into a simple structure. Row 3 middle: child is reading an open picture book, looking at its pages, pages have simple pictures with NO legible writing. Row 3 right: close-up hand lays a marked ruler carefully alongside a plain wooden stick to measure its length, ruler ticks clearly visible, no reading of numeric values required, NO drawing pencil. Each tile must be a real ACTION not a duplicate object cutout. Keep all figures, hands and tools fully inside their own panel, anatomically coherent, uncluttered. The nine cells will be cropped independently. No extra actions.

assets.name: craft-materials

Top-left: three plain BLANK white paper sheets slightly fanned, clean visible straight edges, NO drawings or marks. Top-right: a small set of colored pencils, colored tips in red blue yellow green purple, no text on shafts. Bottom-left: THREE separate transparent colored acetate sheets, red blue yellow, offset with tiny overlaps so their thin see-through material is recognizable, no frame, no demonstration setup or labels.
